key_insight: A task-specific combination of LLMs, protocols, and agent frameworks can improve Agentic Web performance compared with a one-size-fits-all stack.
engineering_relevance: The paper provides a baseline evaluation framework and results that can guide architecture choices for building, governing, and scaling multi-agent web systems.
method: Built MASTIF (Multi-Agent System TestIng Framework) for evaluating Agentic Web systems.
Benchmarked 3 LLMs, 3 protocols, and 4 agent implementation frameworks.
Tested stack combinations on 300 Mind2Web tasks.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports improved task completion, efficiency, and social value stability, along with reduced verbosity and time to complete tasks, across the evaluated technology stacks.
watch_item: The results are baseline-specific and may not generalize across other tasks, environments, or rapidly changing agent technologies.
paper_title: A Baseline Assessment for the Agentic Web Technology Stack
